body: Speed met Apple’s new CEO and immediately started barking and did a backflip in front of him 😭😂 Via; Speed met Apple’s new CEO, John Ternus, and decided to introduce himself by barking and doing a backflip in front of him 😭😂 Ternus recently took over from Tim Cook after spending years leading Apple’s hardware engineering team. Today marked his first major product showcase as CEO, with Apple unveiling its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, alongside the new iPhone 18 Pro lineup. 📱 But even with all the new technology being announced, Speed still managed to bring his own entertainment. Meeting the person running Apple apparently wasn’t a reason to turn the energy down 😭 Imagine becoming Apple’s CEO and one of your first experiences is getting the full Speed introduction 😂

Speed met Apple’s new CEO, John Ternus, and decided to introduce himself by barking and doing a backflip in front of him 😭😂

Ternus recently took over from Tim Cook after spending years leading Apple’s hardware engineering team. Today marked his first major product showcase as CEO, with Apple unveiling its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, alongside the new iPhone 18 Pro lineup. 📱

But even with all the new technology being announced, Speed still managed to bring his own entertainment. Meeting the person running Apple apparently wasn’t a reason to turn the energy down 😭

Imagine becoming Apple’s CEO and one of your first experiences is getting the full Speed introduction 😂
